summary: Gix Internet Ltd., an Israeli foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K announcing a Special General Meeting of Shareholders for December 8, 2026, at 5:00 p.m. Israel time, convening at Meitar | Law Offices in Givatayim; the parallel US equivalent is a notice of special meeting and proxy statement. Agenda items cover amendments to the Articles to rename the company Everything Robotics Ltd., classify the board into three staggered classes, and revise nomination and meeting procedures, plus CEO Amir Nardimon's 2027-2029 employment terms, a Chairman bonus scheme and director option grants. No price, stake or transaction terms are stated; watch for shareholder dissent on the name change and staggered board.
